title: Resilience projects need funding. Green banks could bring them together, researcher says.
summary: A hybrid institutional capital model could package small infrastructure resilience projects to make them attractive to institutional investors, a new research paper proposes.

title: 4 takeaways from the NLIHC national renter survey
summary: Many renters remain stuck between unaffordable rents and a lack of other options, according to the 2025 National Renter Survey by the National Low Income Housing Coalition.

title: New critical infrastructure cybersecurity framework features government, regional council options
summary: The Trump administration has said it wants to push more cybersecurity resilience responsibilities to the state and local levels.

title: Electric commuter rail line extension aims to bring economic benefits to northern Indiana
summary: A branch of the South Shore Line, the Monon Corridor is expected to generate $2.7 billion in private investment to northwestern Indiana when combined with another completed project.

title: $900M in homelessness funding restored to California local governments
summary: The state nearly doubled its prior proposal to fund a program that city leaders have called “the backbone of the state’s local homelessness response system.”

title: Joby, Toyota form electric air taxi joint venture
summary: The new entity aims to support the certification and commercial production of Joby’s eVTOL aircraft. The companies' strategic alliance has been in the works since 2024.

title: World Cup drives record public transit ridership in US match cities
summary: Transit agencies in Atlanta, Los Angeles, Philadelphia and Seattle are reporting new highs in ridership on certain game days.

title: Judge rules against HUD’s ‘rapid, untimely overhaul’ of homeless funding
summary: Although the agency’s “hastily” made changes were deemed procedurally incorrect, the court denied a request to block anti-housing-first policy changes in the next round of Continuum of Care grants.

title: Will US high-speed rail projects ever leave the station?
summary: California’s San Francisco-Los Angeles project looks to the private sector for help, but other privately funded projects are struggling.

title: Discounted AI services coming to California cities, counties as state partners with Anthropic
summary: Local governments in California will receive a 50% discount on Claude, the company’s AI productivity assistant, Gov. Gavin Newsom announced.
